resources.string: Export the SMS you received to a JSONL file. Each line contains one message with the per-install export ID, timestamp, sender and text. Passwords, codes, card and account numbers, national IDs, phone numbers and emails in the text are replaced with tags such as [CARD]. Messages you sent are not exported.
SMS permission is required to export messages
Adds a spam/ham label to each message from on-device classification.
Off: only messages from senders who are not in your contacts are exported.
